enunciado: Implement LinkedQueue with references to the front and the rear. Simulate a bank line: customers 101, 102 and 103 arrive; one is served; 104 and 105 arrive; everyone is served. Show each arrival and each service.
objetivos: Implement a queue with nodes and two references
Keep front and rear consistent in edge cases
pistas: Enqueue adds at the rear in O(1) thanks to the rear reference.
If the queue was empty, the new node is both front and rear.
When it becomes empty after dequeuing, rear must also be null.
